text:
tayla: heads up — after the edge deploy a subset of ws clients got repeated resumes that looked like replays. quota doubled for a few tenants. seeing this in ap-northeast.

ben: saw it too. quick grep shows resume responses with header `x-handoff: true` sometimes missing during weight flip. clients retried to other edge and replayed.

hao: root cause guess: routing change flips shard before proxies finish draining ephemeral session state. proxies accept resume but runtime treats it as new session and charges.

mina: two quick ideas: 1) emit an explicit `handoff=1` in resume_resp so quota can suppress double-counts, 2) add a short grace window (20s) after routing-change where quota estimator ignores a single-session token burst if resume tag present.

tayla: agree. also need telemetry: `ws_resume_handoff.v1` and `ws_doublecharge_by_route.v1`. want a dashboard panel to correlate handoff events with token spikes.

metrics-bot: emit: ws_resume_handoff=33 (6h), ws_doublecharge_by_route: /v1/gen=12, /v1/chat=8. median token bump 95% on affected sessions.

ben: rollout plan: proxy change to include handoff header behind flag, quota change to ignore tagged resumes for 30s, dashboard + alert (page if doublecharge > 20/10m). canary eu/ap small shard 4h.

hao: note: need tenant allowlist to opt-out (enterprise billing won't want auto-suppression). also add a cleanup task to clear handoff markers after 5m.

mina: will open dashboard ticket and create alert rule. tayla — can you own proxy PR?

tayla: yep. opening PR and will add feature flag. link when ready.

ben: I'll take quota estimator change. PRs linked here once ready; keep oncall in loop.

metrics-bot: alert created: WS Resume Doublecharge Surge -> #eng-platform-oncall, threshold=20/10m.

mina: thanks team. keep messages short on the PRs so we can fast-track canary. :thumbsup:

ben: ack

hao: ack
